# Barış Salih Babacan — Systems Architect & CTO

> Official technical portfolio and knowledge platform of Barış Salih Babacan, Systems Architect & CTO at Garage.ist. Specializing in distributed P2P systems, local-first / offline-first architectures, content-addressable storage, and psychological fiction.

## Core Profile
- **Role**: CTO @ Garage.ist · Systems Architect · Author
- **Location**: Istanbul, Turkey
- **Email**: barissalih@babacan.me
- **Website**: https://babacan.me
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/barissalihbabacan
- **LinkedIn**: https://linkedin.com/in/barissalihbabacan

## Primary Technical Focus & Philosophy
- **Distributed P2P Systems**: Designing decentralized P2P networks with content-addressable storage (CAS) and identity verification models.
- **Offline-First & Local-First Architectures**: Building resilient systems where user data persists locally on-device using SQLite, Mongoose, or native Git storage, synchronizing state peer-to-peer.
- **Geographic & Spatial Math**: Building interactive 3D/2D orthographic map projections with solar terminator calculations.
